name: When is it necessary to replace my old showerhead with an adjustable one?

mainEntity.name: When is it necessary to replace my old showerhead with an adjustable one?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your old showerhead with an adjustable one if you experience inconsistent spray patterns, mineral buildup that clogs nozzles, or persistent leaks. An upgrade is also beneficial if you desire more customizable showering options, such as different spray modes or a handheld feature for easier cleaning or bathing children/pets. If your current showerhead is simply old, discolored, or no longer aesthetically pleasing, replacement is a straightforward way to refresh your bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace when experiencing inconsistent spray, mineral buildup, leaks, or if you desire customizable options like different spray modes or a handheld feature.
